verdictRationale: The approved, human-selected Chat handoff is technically closed on the integrated product state: immutable neutral ingress and exactly-once receipt semantics are followed by explicit, versioned document, presentation, workbook and artifact_origin mappings through canonical owner commands. Corrective SHA 812793c45f closes consumed-ingress reconciliation, deterministic target replay and DOC/PPT crash windows; workbook port SHA 9a8d7ae5fb closes the adjacent custom-template regression; cleanup SHA d9de65506c makes the mounted proof residue-free. The post-fan-in gate passed 750 migrations, all 30 Chat tests, C3 6/6 and mounted workbook 2/2 with zero fixture residue. Autonomous target selection, UI acceptance and external rendering/provider policy remain outside this backend BVP and are not claimed.
open: EXCLUDED_NOT_BLOCKING: Chat does not autonomously select a target, content or command; a human-approved proposal supplies the explicit target kind and versioned command envelope.
EXCLUDED_NOT_BLOCKING: artifact_origin binds an existing canonical registry origin and canonical JSON hash; it does not claim material bytes or a newly rendered material.

EXCLUDED_NOT_BLOCKING: external PDF/rendering approval and live-provider stability belong to MAT-POL/MAT-MVP-EXPORT and CHAT-NFR; this task proves provider/empty-source failure is fail-closed but does not authorize an external provider.
